method: Original PC generic scalar extractor and original callees 0x5ca830/0x6e6b90 executed in isolated Unicorn x86 emulator, no OS API or game process. All consumed pointers relocated in scratch memory.
limits: Four bounded sample times per carrier, all nodes and channels; not every time or blend state.

Decoder double math differs from native float32/x87; tolerance2e-5*max(1,abs(value),abs(minimum),abs(scale)*endpointMaximum), accounting for cancellation in offset curves; type10 requires exact uint32 equality.
Pose transforms, actor binding, state callbacks, and rendered cutscene playback are outside scalar emulation.
